partition: Original Train only. All eligible75 users: first25 SHA256 12:v224:role:user => final; rest50=>development; all other users train. Eligibility >=6total and>=5fixed479 items. All eval users excluded from developer fits.
support_order: 12:v224:support:user:item; first5 candidate IDs; remaining ALL observed items are answers, including outside479
extra_policy: rating+adaptive alpha .25+.5*(1-known_support/5) using unclipped MF percentile. For secondary MF configs, skip combinations if pure MF developer NDCG lower than first MF; no extra hyperparameter search.
selection: Highest development NDCG@5 among fixed baseline, existing V22/V23 variants and improved variants; ties keep baseline then earliest declared candidate. Freeze selection before final labels.
normalization: Per-user ID-only candidate raw-score midrank percentiles; unclipped MF removes clipping ties. No label-derived scaling or posthoc calibration.
final_fit: After selection, refit baseline and selected MF on training+development users, excluding ALL final users. Share fit if same MF settings. Maximum total MF fits5, Content fits2.
final: Read sealed final support/answers only after selection+final fits. Evaluate fixed baseline/V22 common479/V23 noMMR and defaultMMR/selected exactly once. Never retune on final.
uncertainty: paired user bootstrap20000 seed12. Reused source population; one-time V24 heldout is user-disjoint within this run, not pristine external evidence.
